note: The owner's own voice-over for the demo video, recorded on 18 October 2026 with a BOYA BY-M1 Pro lavalier into QuickTime on a MacBook Pro (48 kHz, mono). The recordings stay out of the repository, under dist/demo-video/voice/ (VOICE); voice-over.mjs cuts each line from its recording, between `from` and `to` seconds, and writes <id>.wav beside them. The assembler places a line by its id like one of Thinkle's.

recordings.intro-06.aifc: Introduction, take 6: the 55-word text of voice-over-script.md.
recordings.built-01.aifc: The Built-with scene, take 1: the 36-word text.

owner_intro_2.text: Chess is a game most families never play together,

owner_intro_3.text: because the stronger player almost always wins.

owner_intro_4.text: Dice Chess adds three dice, and luck gives everyone a chance.

owner_intro_5.text: Here, children and parents play it in the same tournaments.

owner_intro_6.text: I built Dice Chess for Fire TV for the living room: one TV, one remote.

owner_built_1.text: I built it with React Native for Vega on Vega SDK 0.24.

owner_built_2.text: It runs on Vega OS: what you saw was recorded on the Vega Virtual Device, and this is it on a Fire TV Stick.
